function.description: Get a wallet's realized-PnL TIME SERIES on Jupiter Prediction over an interval — use solana.predict.profile instead for a single lifetime snapshot rather than a series. realizedPnlUsd per data point is an exact-decimal USD string with a raw realizedPnlUsdMicro sibling. NOTE: as of 2026-07-24 the provider's pnl-history route is documented but returns 404 upstream for every wallet (a provider-side outage, not removal) — prefer solana.predict.profile until it is restored upstream.
function.name: solana__predict_pnl_history_get

count.description: Number of data points to return, 1-100 (Vex owner-wide cap; provider default 10 when omitted).

walletAddress.description: The wallet ACCOUNT to read, as a Solana address (not a token mint or a position key). Defaults to the session's selected Solana wallet — omit it to read your own. Under session scope a DIFFERENT address is rejected.
